mentions.name: wishpool
mentions.description: A platform where anyone can post an idea for something they wish existed — an app, a game, a tool, or anything else — and share it. Ideas gain momentum as more people back them and start getting built, either by AI or by community makers, aiming to turn crowd energy into real progress.
mentions.audience: Anyone can post ideas; ideas get built by AI or community makers
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve been working on an idea wishpool.

https://anyidea.fun

Anyone can post an idea for something they wish existed — an app, a game, a tool, or anything else — and share it.
When more people back an idea, it gains momentum and starts getting built, either by AI or by community makers. The goal is to turn crowd energy into real progress.
